name: Blade_Sunforged

unity.note: FBX: Blender -Y forward becomes Unity +Z. Positions below are in the model root's space, Unity axes.

notes: Sunforged Blade (damage x1.8, costs 40 shards). Broad golden blade with a sun-disc guard. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.
